notes.title: Content update and summer sale!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32380238/b6b18f0b6abc27ee9b6fa63fe38c0a45b523e913.png[/img]

After a couple of weeks of low news, I’m happy to announce the v1.04 content update to BadLands RoadTrip! So, what’s new?

[list]
[*] New parts! The punch rocket and anti-gravity mine can now be unlocked. Find the upgrade cube [b]somewhere[/b] in the world.
[*] Robots have been tweaked. Barrels have been changed and the snipers can now actually hit you!
[*] The final boss battle has been changed back to the original intended showdown.
[*] Dull places have been filled with more bots.
[*] Many bug fixes
[/list]

And to top it all off, we have the summer sale! BLuRT is now 15% off.

Happy summer, everyone!

notes.title: First update!
notes.content:
It’s time for BluRT’s first update! Here’s what’s new:

[*] Frame drops at enemy loading have been greatly reduced,
[*] Chinese translation had text boxes that would not go away, now they close properly.
[*] Font in the main menu is changed, because it did not display the Spanish translation correctly
[*] When completing a quest, the reward is shown near ‘Quest Complete’
[*] The language select screen now has every language written in its own language, so you don’t have to speak another language to choose your own language.

...and there is more to come! 

I hope you like it.
